description: Interim backstop, lands as amendment to PR #82. Remove both empty-pid filters (layout_index.ex:134,173); every shard becomes a segment (empty pids allowed; nil metadata_materializer -> [] for tag 0). lookup_key! returns {range, []} -> StorageRacing's currently-dead {_range, []} branch fires -> layout_lookup_failed. REVERT get_next_segment gap-skip (bedrock-dwu fix) to exact-boundary semantics — on a total-coverage tree the asymmetry never manifests; skipping uncovered shards in KeySelector resolution would silently drop live keys. Keep the tn5 dedup fix. Update tests: gap tests become uncovered-segment-with-[]-pids tests; add lookup_key! -> layout_lookup_failed regression. TDD.
title: LayoutIndex total-coverage backstop: keep pid-less shards, loud failure, exact next-segment
